annotations.title: Compile & Route PCB in Cloud Enclave

description: Primary full-featured synthesis tool: compile and route a PCB (.kicad_pcb, .dsn, .ato, .tsx, or sample_id) to 100% completion and 0 native KiCad DRC errors, supporting ECO passes, rush delivery, and inline promo/grant codes. Call after calligraphy_preflight_audit. Returns JSON job_id, status, pricing, and Stripe/USDC payment links. Example: sample_id='2l_rp2040', requested_sku='vibe_micro'.

customer_email.description: Customer engineering email for receipts, ECO licenses, and invoicing.

export_control_certified.description: Certify EAR99 commercial export compliance and non-sanctioned jurisdiction status.

filename.description: Uploaded CAD filename with extension to select the parser.

include_eco_pass.description: Enable +50% 30-Day Unlimited ECO Re-Spin License on 2L tiers.

no_itar_certified.description: Certify uploaded PCB design contains no ITAR-controlled defense articles.

preserve_existing_copper.description: Lock existing routed copper for surgical Rev-B ECO partial reroutes.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to CAD file (STDIO) or sample_id.

requested_sku.description: Target synthesis tier SKU (vibe_micro, basic_2l, route_3d, turnkey_full).

retention_policy.description: Enclave vault retention policy: auto_purge_on_download or expire_24h TTL.

rush_delivery.description: Enable +35% Priority Enclave Rush synthesis queue turnaround.

showcase_opt_in.description: Opt in to anonymized raster showcase gallery (optional for cohort).

social_or_repo_url.description: Public HTTPS GitHub or social URL for OPENHW grant verification.

target_nets.description: Optional list of specific net names for Rev-B ECO reroutes.

tos_accepted.description: Accept Calligraphy Systems Terms of Service and liability cap.

upload_b64.description: Base64-encoded binary CAD file or .zip project bundle.

name: calligraphy_compile_board
title: Compile & Route PCB in Cloud Enclave
